name: Domain Shift with Implicit Structure Induction
description: Removed all group-theoretic terminology (symmetric group, transposition, subgroup) and deleted the explicit statement that the generating set is minimal. Reframed the problem using hardware variable exchange instructions. This removes the direct "it's a tree" affordance, forcing the model to deduce from the $m=n-1$ constraint and the universal permutation guarantee that the instruction graph is a spanning tree, and that isolating a swap requires every edge on the unique path between the variables.
